secrets.name: TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID
secrets.description: Twilio account SID (from the Twilio console dashboard) — enables real outbound calls from the Phone app.

secrets.name: TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN
secrets.description: Twilio auth token (from the Twilio console dashboard) — paired with the account SID.

secrets.name: TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER
secrets.description: Your verified Twilio phone number in E.164 (e.g. +441234567890) that outbound calls are placed from.
